definitions.explanation: The soft, fluffy feathers of birds, especially the fine underfeathers used as insulating material in bedding and clothing. Also refers to bird feathers in general.

examples.japanese: {羽毛|うもう}ぶとん⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{軽|かる}くて→軽い：00785_karui⟧⟦{暖|あたた}かい→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧。
examples.english: Down comforters are light and warm.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{羽毛|うもう}⟦ジャケット→ジャケット：04522_jaketto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{真冬|まふゆ}→真冬：20587_mafuyu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧⟦{暖|あたた}かい→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧。
examples.english: This down jacket is warm enough even in the middle of winter.

examples.japanese: {水鳥|みずどり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{羽毛|うもう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧はじく⟦{性質|せいしつ}→性質：01638_seishitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧な⟦{寝具|しんぐ}→寝具：12391_shingu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{重宝|ちょうほう}→重宝：14415_chouhou⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Waterfowl down has water-repelling properties, so it is valued as a material for high-quality bedding.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly encountered in compound words related to bedding and clothing products. {羽毛|うもう}ぶとん (down comforter) is by far the most frequent collocation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {羽毛|うもう}ぶとん (down comforter/duvet)
- {羽毛|うもう}⟦ジャケット→ジャケット：04522_jaketto⟧ (down jacket)
- {羽毛|うもう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (made with down)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {羽|はね}: feather, wing (general everyday word for individual feathers)
- ⟦ダウン→ダウン：00035_daun⟧: down (loanword, used interchangeably in product names like ⟦ダウンジャケット→ダウンジャケット：27310_daunjaketto⟧)
